sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The event requires specialist Site Management Services to support the safe and effective planning, organisation and delivery of Vivid Sydney across multiple event zones. The services include the provision of appropriately licenced and experienced site management personnel and general labour for Vivid Sydney 2027, 2028 and 2029 with two optional 1-year extensions for Vivid Sydney 2030 and 2031 at DNSW’s sole discretion.

This procurement is intended to engage an experienced Contractor with the capability to deliver safe, high-quality and seamlessly integrated Site Management Services that meet the operational, technical and stakeholder requirements of the program.

For further information, refer to the RFT documents under the Requirements section of this opportunity.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: The RFT documents under the Requirements section of this opportunity contains a detailed description of Destination NSW's requirements for Vivid Sydney and should be considered carefully by all respondents.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
All enquiries regarding the procurement, clarifications and questions regarding the RFT Document(s) must be in writing by email to melanie.chong@dnsw.com.au, with 'RFT-12634672652 Vivid Sydney Site Management Services' in the subject line and directed to Rochelle Kirk. Alternatively, you may raise enquiries via the Q&A function in the Tender portal of Buy NSW.

All enquiries relating to registration, log-in or signup issues, issues with electronic lodgement of responses and profile editing matters must be directed to buy NSW Service Desk by emailing buy.nsw@customerservice.nsw.gov.au or calling 1800 679 289.

The timeframe for submitting clarification questions regarding this RFT is until 21 September 2026. Please note a briefing session has also been scheduled.

Refer to the RFT documents & Requirements section of this Opportunity for further details.
